title_en: At the Aviation Field, in the Turdiu Complex, a business unit for sale with a regular floor plan, ideal for investment!!!
description_en: At the Aviation Field, in the Turdiu Complex, a business unit for sale with a regular floor plan, ideal for investment!!! The unit is located in the Turdiu Complex, a new and quality building. The property has an area of ​​85.78 m2 gross and 77.13 m2 net. It is organized in an open space environment with 1 toilet. The store has a glass facade which allows you to advertise your business.
